data.one_liner: A Flutter barcode generator library for 1D and 2D machine-readable barcodes.
data.what_it_does: Generates and displays various one-dimensional (like Code128, EAN) and two-dimensional (like QR Code, Data Matrix) barcodes within the widget tree. Supports customization of colors, modules, and text placement.
use_when: You need to display generated barcodes like QR codes or product codes in your app.
You are already using Syncfusion components and want a consistent styling ecosystem.
avoid_when: You do not have a Syncfusion commercial or community license.
You only need to scan barcodes rather than generate them.
strengths: Supports multiple popular 1D and 2D symbologies including QR Code and Data Matrix.
Allows extensive visual customization of colors, modules, and text representation.
weaknesses: Commercial license required for production usage.
Large library footprint typical of enterprise component suites.
data.minimal_example:
Container(
  height: 200,
  child: SfBarcodeGenerator(
    value: 'www.syncfusion.com',
    symbology: QRCode(),
  ),
)
